bootstrap.method: two-sided percentile; stratified whole independent situations; approximate coverage

configuration.generation: seeded rejection on visible bounds only; top-two-card straight or replicate-zero board Broadway split; rainbow/two-tone board; global suit-canonical uniqueness; exclude discovery rank/suit class; no decision-based rejection
configuration.sampling: 16 independent weighted draws with replacement from all 990 compatible holdings; same holding across arms/difficulties/policies

controls.safeguard: exact own visible minimum share >= actual contestable call odds => never fold (raising may continue aggressively); forced split => check/call; never fold profitable guaranteed calls
controls.callHeavy: otherwise call probability .95 if call/livePot<=.4, .80 if <=.7, .55 otherwise; fold residual; check when free
controls.raising: outside forced split: raise probability .45 with own category>=two-pair, .20 otherwise; conditional raise sizes minimum/intermediate/all-in with probabilities .40/.35/.25; intermediate=floor((min+max)/2); if no raise use call branch; remaining mass calls with probability .85/.55/.20 for call/livePot<=.4/<=.7/>.7, folds residual; free check
controls.randomness: common seed by situation/range/draw/policy, reset for each arm and difficulty; sequential public decision random uniforms

gates.development: 48 situations, zero failures, mechanical checks pass, every one of nine means >0, activation in all 12 strata
gates.confirmation: 120 situations, zero failures, mechanical checks pass, every one of nine adjusted lower bounds >0; only development-qualified difficulties
gates.rescue: none: no extra samples, alternative candidate or post-hoc restriction
